## Description

Combines `REPLICATION-PartA.md` and `REPLICATION-PartB.md` into `REPLICATION.md`, dropping lines that start with `> INSTRUCTIONS`. It removes the two parts with `git rm` and commits the result as "Merged report". An existing `REPLICATION.md` is overwritten. When either part is missing, it stops with an error.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/50_merge-parts.sh
```

### Environment Variables

- `jiraticket` - When set, commit messages start with `<jiraticket> #comment [skip ci]`; otherwise with `[skip ci]`.
